references.title: Add students and enroll them into a course
references.question: Q1
references.take: A single add-students step supports manual entry or CSV import and previews the target course before enrollment.

references.title: Select team members before course invitation
references.question: Q2
references.take: A selected-count table with search, filters, and a Continue step makes the invite impact explicit before dates and reminders.

references.title: Assign filtered workers to a course
references.question: Q2
references.take: Assign workers to course shows Selected 96 of 96 items, worker metadata, a whole-team warning and Continue into Schedule Assignment. Duplicate learners and net-new enrollment counts are not shown.

references.title: Add people or teams to a project
references.question: Q1
references.take: The project-member picker accepts either people or teams and shows existing access, making group attachment a first-class path.

references.title: Select members from a searchable roster
references.question: Q2
references.take: A searchable, role-filtered member picker shows 1 selected and Add 1 member. This is a team-access analogy for a count-bearing enrollment confirmation.

references.title: Add a group with automatic membership expansion
references.question: Q1
references.take: Policy excerpt from a work-management flow: choosing a group expands its current members; later membership changes do not update previous assignments or mentions. This is explicit snapshot behavior, not live course-group sync.

references.title: Course classroom groups tab
references.question: Q1
references.take: A classroom-scoped Groups tab keeps learner groups alongside Students and returns to a visible group card after the action, preserving course context.

references.title: User groups roster with member count
references.question: Q2
references.take: The group roster ends with a named group and visible member avatars plus count, giving an immediate impact check after selection.

references.title: Teacher class detail with member tab
references.question: Q2
references.take: A teacher-facing class detail flow keeps class content and membership in adjacent tabs, making the roster a course-level destination.

references.title: Class member visibility gated by joining
references.question: Q2
references.take: The class detail exposes a Members tab but gates its roster until the learner joins, a counter-example for transparent pre-enrollment review.

references.title: Group roster with capacity and roles
references.question: Q2
references.take: The group view surfaces current membership as 3/10 and labels each member, combining capacity and role context in the roster itself.
